paragraphs.text: "I don't like that sort of thing.  I'm too busy to be worried with nonsense, and I think it's dreadful to break up families so. Now don't say any more about it.  Meg's wedding has turned all our heads, and we talk of nothing but lovers and such absurdities.  I don't wish to get cross, so let's change the subject;"  and Jo looked quite ready to fling cold water on the slightest provocation.
Whatever his feelings might have been, Laurie found a vent for them in a long low whistle and the fearful prediction as they parted at the gate, "Mark my words, Jo, you'll go next."
